Class ControllerBrowsePosts

java.lang.Object
guiBrowsePosts.ControllerBrowsePosts
public class ControllerBrowsePosts extends Object

Title: ControllerViewPosts Class.

Description: Controller for the Browse Posts page. Provides protected static methods invoked by ViewBrowsePosts button and selection handlers. Responsibilities:

  • Load and display the list of posts for a selected thread.
  • When a post is selected, load its replies and mark the post and all its visible replies as read for the current user.
  • Handle navigation (Return → Student Home, Logout, Quit).
This controller is a collection of protected static methods — it is never instantiated. All widget access goes through the public static fields of ViewBrowsePosts.

  • Method Details

    • doLoadPosts

      protected static void doLoadPosts()

      Method: doLoadPosts()

      Description: Reads the selected DiscussionThread from the ComboBox, queries the database for all non-deleted Posts in that thread, and populates ViewBrowsePosts.listview_Posts. The parallel postIds list is rebuilt so that a subsequent doSelectPost() call can retrieve the correct postId by index. Any previously shown replies are cleared.

    • doSelectPost

      protected static void doSelectPost()

      Method: doSelectPost()

      Description: Fires when the user clicks a row in the Posts ListView. It:

      1. Retrieves the selected index and the corresponding postId.
      2. Marks the post as read for the current user.
      3. Loads all replies for that post from the database.
      4. Marks every visible reply as read for the current user.
      5. Populates ViewBrowsePosts.listview_Posts with formatted Strings.
      6. Refreshes the posts list so the read indicator (✓/○) updates immediately.
